notes: Business Standard, 3 Dec 2013, "Canara Bank cuts term deposit rates": cuts to domestic and NRO term deposits of Rs 1 crore and above, effective that Tuesday (3 Dec 2013). The article also states senior citizens get an additional 0.50% on domestic term deposits generally, but does not print the resulting rate for these buckets, so no senior row is added.
